name: Diagrammatic Minimalism
tagline: Off-white page with black hairline-outlined nested circles, a single vermilion core, bold Jost titles and generous whitespace (extended from a single-slide specimen)

palette.description: Warm off-white, black ink outlines, light taupe ring and one vermilion accent

typography.style: Geometric Jost throughout, heavy 900 titles over tracked uppercase kickers

best_for: Explaining one core idea or framework through a single master diagram, with sparse supporting text. Suits workshops, planning and design-thinking talks.
avoid_for: Data-dense reports or dashboards that need many numbers per slide.
